name: PII Baseline
description: Personal identifiable information hygiene: redacts email addresses, phone numbers, and IP addresses out of prompts, tool inputs, and tool outputs before they reach AI context, and flags MAC address exposure for a written reason. Uses detection-based rules with fail-mode open to minimise false-positive disruption.

rules.name: Redact email addresses, phone numbers, and IP addresses
rules.description: Scans user prompts, tool call inputs, and tool outputs for email addresses, phone numbers, and IPv4/IPv6 addresses. Redacts matches and allows execution to proceed with the sanitised data.

rules.name: Require justification for MAC address exposure
rules.description: Detects hardware (MAC) addresses in colon- or hyphen-separated form. Requires a written reason before proceeding — MAC_ADDRESS is not yet a supported pii_redact category, so this cannot auto-redact until that lands.
